name: Shiina Suiko
source:
Main heroine.

Yuusuke's childhood friend, a beautiful girl who grew up in a wealthy and happy family. She is intelligent and fearless. She is immune to violence and malice, and can be naive and impulsive. She used to live next door to Yuusuke, but moved to Tokyo about 10 years ago due to her father's job. She returned to live next door after her grandfather's death and her father's overseas assignment. Her father is the head of Mutoh Heavy Industries' overseas business division.

[From the [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=3764144&srsltid=AU7gw4XmBVV4agfY6JSt8NMR-xD2vsTe-ggrmorkQdPzbG-oKgzYb0g9]Megastore October 2026 Issue.[/url]]
